name: grid9x9
description: Baseline grid QCCD for BB [[144,12,12]]: a 9x9 lattice of junctions with a trap in the middle of each of the 144 wires. 49 degree-4 X-junctions, 28 degree-3 T-junctions and 4 degree-2 bends, all read off the incidence count.

provenance.note: 2ab - a - b = 144 traps at a = b = 9, one per data qubit

trap.note: general-purpose trap: gate, measure and cool all available

1q_gate.note: r = 1 - F_avg = 1.38e-5; Stim p = 3r/2 = 2.07e-5, written by qccd-noise@3. Duration: the model's example clock, since neither its Sec. 3 nor (outside WISE) the deck gives one
1q_gate.source: Helios Nominal Noise Model Sec. 1 and Sec. 7

cool.note: reference ground-state cooling. It leaves the gate-mode occupation 0.05 that qccd-noise@3's cooled gate error already includes; the ledger counts the excess from 0
cool.source: Helios Nominal Noise Model Sec. 3 and Sec. 4

gate_swap.source: QCCD Transport Architectures deck, Cyclone T3

curve.label: a crystal rotation: the C2LR reorder-or-not figures, the only ones either document gives
curve.source: Helios Nominal Noise Model Sec. 5; QCCD Transport Architectures deck, C2LR T5

3.label: a three-rail crossing: 100 us (both documents); heat is the H-series proxy per crossing
3.source: QCCD Transport Architectures deck, Cyclone T2; Helios Nominal Noise Model Sec. 4 and Sec. 7

4.label: a four-rail crossing: 120 us; heat is the H-series proxy per crossing
4.source: QCCD Transport Architectures deck, Cyclone T2; Helios Nominal Noise Model Sec. 4

measure.note: symmetric readout, of the total SPAM 4.8e-4. Duration marked a placeholder by the model
measure.source: Helios Nominal Noise Model Sec. 1 and Sec. 3

curve.label: merge two chains: 80 us; no separate heat, grouped with the split
curve.source: Helios Nominal Noise Model Sec. 5 and Sec. 7

ms_gate.note: native 2Q gate, 70 us; r = 5.5e-4 less the 1.1e-5 pre-gate cooling leaves in the idle window. max_quanta is R7's budget, which the model calls a scheduler setting
ms_gate.source: Helios Nominal Noise Model Sec. 1, Sec. 3 and Sec. 4

reset.note: physical prep / reset. Duration marked a placeholder by the model
reset.source: Helios Nominal Noise Model Sec. 1 and Sec. 3

curve.label: shuttle one rail: 5 us, 0.1 quanta
curve.source: Helios Nominal Noise Model Sec. 5 and Sec. 7

curve.label: split one chain: 80 us, 2 quanta (the lower of the model's two experiments, 2 or 4.16); the merge's heat is grouped here
curve.source: Helios Nominal Noise Model Sec. 5 and Sec. 7

z_gate.note: a frame change is virtual: the model's idle-window convention names 'virtual frame changes' among the things that take no physical operation

heating.note: background stretch-mode heating, 3 quanta/s, assumed from H-series; R17: accrues whether or not the ion moves

species.note: T_coh_s is the model's T_lin, for the coarse idle estimate of qccd.cost.physical; qccd-noise@3 writes the idle channels itself

extra.note: one ion, one trap to the next; the lowest common denominator move
